# The search campaign

## Standing rules

- One conventional commit per coherent unit.

## P0 — The schema

After: none

Add the tables.

## P1 — The importer

After: P0

Load the records.

## P2 — Search

After: P0

Index the records and query them.

## P3 — Export

After: P0

Write the records out.

## P4 — Release

After: all

Tag it.
